Sylas's E2 chain pull is a projectile and IS blocked; Hijack on Yasuo requires an airborne target (correctly stated).
audit.why: Kit flags: Sylas E projectile (Wind Wall-blockable); Sylas Q is ground-targeted AoE. Yasuo W 25s rank 1, 4s duration; E 0.5s per-target dash; R 70s.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns and do's now state the E2-blocked / Q-unblocked split with real numbers.

edits.before: - Yasuo Wind Wall: matchup-defining — Blocks every projectile for its duration — hold your poke until it is spent. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Abscond (shield-dash) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Yasuo Wind Wall (W): 25s at rank 1 for a 4s wall — it blocks your E2 chain pull but never your ground-cast Chain Lash. Hold the chain until it is spent; keep Q-ing through it. - Your E Abscond has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: when it goes right.

edits.before: E-shield in, E2-chain, Q-W with whirls between, heal out — the full brawl string he answered with one rotation and regret.
edits.after: Wind Wall cannot stop the E2 pull once you are inside it — dash first, then chain, and his 4-second wall guards empty air.

edits.before: Chaining into a loaded CC with W down — Sylas without the heal is a mage who chose melee for the aesthetic.
edits.after: His first crit item flips extended trades — flow shield plus crits out-DPS your burst, so shorten every trade there.

edits.before: Yasuo wins by landing Wind Wall, denying your pattern, and starting the fight your kit wanted ten seconds later.
edits.after: Yasuo wins by walling your chain pull, eating your burst with the flow shield, and outscaling at first crit item.

edits.before: Q-poke the wave contacts — the chain detonation chips while you wait for the real kit at 3.
edits.after: Yasuo is weak level 1 before E — Chain Lash trades win while he can only walk up to the wave.

edits.before: W joins: the heal-strike makes even trades dishonest — yours refunds, his doesn't.
edits.after: He still lacks E dash mobility at 2 — the heal-strike keeps trades yours a level more.

edits.before: First item spike: full chains with a stolen ult delete or out-brawl anything mid offers.
edits.after: First crit item is his: flow shield plus sustained crits out-duel your burst — trade short.
